chunks: My father narrated to him, may God be pleased with him, who said: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated to me, from Musa ibn Umar, from Abdullah ibn Jabalah, from Hanan ibn Sadeer, who said:

I entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) while I was wearing black shoes. He said to me: 'What is with you regarding wearing black shoes? Do you not know that there are three attributes in them?' I said: 'What are they? May I be your ransom.' He said: 'They weaken the vision, relax the remembrance (of God), and cause depression. And besides that, they are the attire of the oppressors. You should wear yellow shoes, for in them are three attributes.' I said: 'What are they?' He said: 'They sharpen the vision, strengthen the remembrance (of God), and remove depression. And besides that, they are the attire of the Prophets (peace be upon them).'
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and physical benefits of wearing yellow shoes according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) guidance on the spiritual psychology of attire, linking black shoes to the arrogance of Pharaoh-like oppressors and yellow shoes to the humility of the Prophets. This tradition reflects the Shia emphasis on *zuhd* (asceticism) and the belief that external appearance influences internal spiritual states, a concept further elaborated in later scholarly works on *adab* (etiquette). The contrast highlights how simple acts of worship, like dressing, serve as reminders of one's spiritual station and connection to divine lineage.
